#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS calendar entry for the project kickoff meeting."""
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone


def next_monday(today):
    """First Monday strictly after today (if today is Monday, +7 days)."""
    days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday == 0
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def local_offset_str(now):
    offset = now.utcoffset()
    total_minutes = int(offset.total_seconds() // 60)
    sign = "+" if total_minutes >= 0 else "-"
    total_minutes = abs(total_minutes)
    return f"{sign}{total_minutes // 60:02d}{total_minutes % 60:02d}"


today = date.today()
monday = next_monday(today)

now_local = datetime.now().astimezone()
offset_str = local_offset_str(now_local)
tz_name = now_local.tzname()

start = datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 10, 0, tzinfo=now_local.tzinfo)
end = datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 12, 0, tzinfo=now_local.tzinfo)
dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar"

ics = "\r\n".join(
    [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
        f"DTSTART:{start.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}{offset_str}",
        f"DTEND:{end.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}{offset_str}",
        "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ]
)

path = "project_kickoff.ics"
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(ics)

print(f"Event date:      {monday.isoformat()} (next Monday)")
print(f"Start (local):   {start.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')} {tz_name} (UTC{offset_str})")
print(f"End (local):     {end.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')} {tz_name} (UTC{offset_str})")
print(f"Duration:        2 hours")
print(f"ICS file:        {path}")
print(f"UID:             {uid}")

# Validate by re-parsing if icalendar is available
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar

    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        cal = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
    events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
    assert len(events) == 1, "expected exactly one VEVENT"
    print("Validation:      PASS (parsed with icalendar)")
except ImportError:
    print("Validation:      SKIPPED (icalendar not installed; manual format check only)")
